summary: Long-term (10–12 months) and short-term (1–2 months) residencies with access to anagama, train, cross-draft wood/gas/soda/salt, and gas kilns. Applications currently closed; rolling applications accepted for 2027–2028 cycle.
commitment: 10–12 months (long-term) or 1–2 months (short-term), typically starting July, August, or September
evidence_sentence: Short-term residents have access to anagama, train, and cross-draft wood/gas/soda/salt kilns during their 1-2 month residency.
evidence_quote: Residents have access to a variety of kilns and resources through-out the year, including: 250 cu. ft. Anagama kiln, 60 cu. ft. Train wood fire kiln, 25 cu. ft. Cross Draft wood/gas/soda/salt kiln
pay_text: $1200 per month includes housing, studio, utilities; materials and firing fees are artist's responsibility
